title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent works with GitHub, Asana and Jira through MCP servers
summary: The briefing accurately reports the paused rollout, administrator enablement and Copilot licensing requirement. Its app controls are documented, and the searches did not establish an MCP-specific control for Channel Agent. It also correctly reports the conflicting Microsoft guidance about file DLP protection.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described which Channel Agent content would be sent to the third-party MCP servers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" "MCP" data sent sensitivity DLP audit; Teams Channel Agent MCP data sent third party authentication identity user approval actions DLP audit. Opened Channel Agent setup and both cited Purview pages; no Channel Agent MCP outbound-content specification was returned.

claims.claim: Channel Agent checks the requesting user's access before using a file.
claims.quote: When an agent determines that a file will be the best resource to answer a question, it will check the permissions of the requesting user. It won't use files that the requesting user doesn't have access to

claims.claim: The setup page says Channel Agent does not use files whose sensitivity labels prevent extraction.
claims.quote: It won't use files that the requesting user doesn't have access to, files whose sensitivity labels prevent extractions, or files with DLP policies that prevent AI-usage.

claims.claim: The setup page says Channel Agent does not use files with DLP policies preventing AI use, and the briefing flags differing Purview guidance.
claims.quote: It won't use files that the requesting user doesn't have access to, files whose sensitivity labels prevent extractions, or files with DLP policies that prevent AI-usage.

claims.claim: The Purview considerations page says DLP cannot prevent Channel Agent summarizing labeled files identified by a DLP policy.
claims.quote: You can't prevent Channel Agent from summarizing labeled files that are identified by a Microsoft Purview Data Loss Protection policy.
